_comment: Copy to data/codex-rates.json and fill in the USD-per-1M-token prices from your OpenAI plan. Key every rate by the full model slug from the Codex model list (e.g. gpt-6.2-sol): matching is longest-prefix, so a bare family key like 'gpt-6' would price gpt-6.2-astra and gpt-6.2-sol the same although they differ. Use 'codex-default' for runs on the SDK default model. All-zero entries are ignored, so nothing is ever priced as free by mistake. The numbers below are OpenAI's Standard short-context (up to 272K input tokens) API prices as of asOf; gpt-5.6-sol is left out because its listed price was a promotion ending 2026-11-30.
